body:
[A682b] REVIEW READY
Commit: `1e0c5c09f6d5e41c8a80ec5e6179c1c762b94086` on `789-yosys-tool-job`, two round-2 commits atop `fddf3671`. Pushed fast-forward after the privacy check; working tree clean.

R707-1-01: the key now binds the generated build inputs, including workflow and job environment, transforms, budget exports, and the repository script read by the build. Environment and transform plants fail on `fddf3671` and pass here.
R707-1-02: a named retention judge holds both derived jobs against the template. All ten generator mutants are refused by name here; eight survived the old judges.
S1: declined. The small warm-hit saving does not affect the cold budget; preserving the moved cache step avoids an additional behavior change.

Validation: 32 gates on each of two interpreters, 64 runs, every rc 0. Includes `ci_gate_workflows.py --check`, `ci_gate_workflows_selftest.py`, the full CI scheduling and evidence controls, `ci_events.py --check` and `--selftest`, `act_ci.py --selftest`, the 0555 runner contract gate, and docs gates with the pinned renderer. Offline sandbox validation accepts all four workflows and orders tool -> consumer -> aggregate. No live act execution.

Hosted measurements at this exact head, run 40321654840:
- Cold new-key tool job: 12m47s, success; build step 12m26s. Cache miss followed by successful save: https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/actions/runs/40321654840/job/121571465201
- Cached `yosys-elaboration`: 12m45s, success; exact-key restore 2s, no build, every retained check passed: https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/actions/runs/40321654840/job/121577793452
- `rtl-fast` aggregate: success. This head edits the generated workflow. No timeout raised; STOP not triggered.

Acceptance: implementation, gates, wording fix and both hosted measurements met. Live act replay remains owed, so the prepared PR body retains `Relates to #789`. The docs and elaborate workflows passed; the final snapshot still has the manifest and rtl-full queued. Independent re-review and merge-candidate validation remain pending.

HANDOFF.md and PR-BODY.md are finalized with file:line reasons, planted checks, failing words, gate table and hosted receipts. The receipt index records relative files, sizes and SHA-256. No PR comment or body was edited.
